```artifact
@test_suite
Feature: Speciality and Doctor Management System

  Background:
    # No preconditions or states are specified in the related requirements

  Scenario Outline: Adding a Doctor with Speciality Id
    Given there is an attempt to add a doctor with a Speciality Id
    When the system processes the addition
    Then the system should either:
      # Normal case
      - if the Speciality Id exists, the doctor is added successfully
      # Error case
      - if the Speciality Id does not exist, an exception error message "Speciality does not exist" should be displayed

  Scenario: Adding a Doctor without Speciality Id
    Given there is an attempt to add a doctor without a Speciality Id
    When the system processes the addition
    Then an exception error message "Speciality does not exist" should be displayed

  Scenario Outline: Adding a Doctor with Generated Id
    Given there is an attempt to add a doctor with a Generated Id
    When the system processes the addition
    Then the system should:
      # Normal case
      - create a unique Doctor Id
      - display the Doctor Name, Age, Sex, Qualification & Experience

  Scenario: Adding a Doctor without Generated Id
    Given there is an attempt to add a doctor without a Generated Id
    When the system processes the addition
    Then an exception error message "Doctor does not exist" should be displayed

  Scenario Outline: Editing/Updating a Doctor
    Given there is an attempt to edit/update a doctor
    When the system processes the edit/update
    Then the system should display:
      # Normal case
      - the Doctor Id, Doctor Name, Age, Sex, Experience and Qualification for modification
      # Error case
      - if the Doctor does not exist, an exception error message "Doctor does not exist" should be displayed

  Scenario: Editing/Updating a Doctor without Id
    Given there is an attempt to edit/update a doctor without an Id
    When the system processes the edit/update
    Then an exception error message "Doctor does not exist" should be displayed

  Scenario Outline: Deleting a Doctor
    Given there is an attempt to delete a doctor
    When the system checks for open Patient Consultation Requests
    Then the system should:
      # Normal case
      - if no open requests, proceed with deletion
      # Error case
      - if there are open requests, display "Doctor has open Consultation Requests - cannot delete"

  Scenario: Deleting a Doctor with Open Consultation Requests
    Given there is an attempt to delete a doctor with open Patient Consultation Requests
    When the system checks for open Patient Consultation Requests
    Then an exception error message "Doctor has open Consultation Requests - cannot delete" should be displayed

  Scenario Outline: Adding a Chemist/Lab
    Given there is an attempt to add a Chemist/Lab
    When the system processes the addition
    Then the system should:
      # Normal case
      - create a unique Chemist/Lab Id
      - display the Chemist/Lab Flag, Chemist Lab Name, Chemist Lab Address and Chemist Lab Contact Details

  Scenario: Adding a Chemist/Lab without Id
    Given there is an attempt to add a Chemist/Lab without an Id
    When the system processes the addition
    Then an exception error message "Doctor does not exist" should be displayed

  Scenario: Editing/Updating a Chemist/Lab
    Given there is an attempt to edit/update a Chemist/Lab
    When the system processes the edit/update
    Then the system should display:
      # Normal case
      - the Chemist/Lab Id, Chemist Lab Flag, Chemist Lab Name, Chemist Lab Address and Chemist Lab Contact Details for modification
      # Error case
      - if the Chemist/Lab does not exist, an exception error message "Doctor does not exist" should be displayed

  Scenario: Editing/Updating a Chemist/Lab without Id
    Given there is an attempt to edit/update a Chemist/Lab without an Id
    When the system processes the edit/update
    Then an exception error message "Doctor does not exist" should be displayed
```
